About Me

I Create. I Impact.
I Study Life.

My name is Olalekan Shinaayo Ezekiel. In Web3, I am simply Shinaayo. I joined the space in March 2022 with nothing but conviction that the internet was being rebuilt from the ground up, and that people who could understand it deeply and communicate it clearly would be at the center of that shift.

The early days were not smooth. I navigated noise, skepticism, and a steep learning curve with very little structure. What carried me through was faith and discipline. I did not wait for everything to be perfect before I started building. I began writing threads when my audience was small. I contributed to communities before anyone was watching. I showed up before I was invited.

"I grow what others struggle to articulate. A believer living in Him. Structure over hype, faith before noise, execution that speaks louder than claims."

As a Microbiology student at FUOYE, I developed a rare analytical lens. Just as microbial ecosystems operate in invisible layers to shape visible outcomes, the most important work in Web3 happens beneath the surface. In narratives, community threads, and quiet consistency that compounds into real growth.

I create through educational threads, long-form articles, and video content that makes complex DeFi concepts accessible. I impact by embedding deeply in projects as a genuine builder. Lead Ambassador, KOL Manager, Community Moderator, Project Advisor, and Core Team contributor across 40+ projects. I study life through scripture, science, people, and the evolving architecture of decentralized systems.

Beyond Web3 and academics, I am a gender impactor. I guide men on presentation, self-discipline, personal branding, financial thinking, how to dress, how to carry themselves with purpose and standard. I am also a Worker of God in the Anglican Students Fellowship at FUOYE, where faith is not a side note but the foundation of everything I do.

I am not here for hype cycles. I am here to build what lasts.

Above the noise.
Built to soar.

DeFi Expertise

Why DeFi is
where I live.

Decentralized Finance is not just a sector I write about. It is a system I understand at a structural level. I have spent years studying how liquidity moves, how yield is generated, how governance evolves, and how protocols compete for real economic activity.

My microbiology background gives me a rare edge. Just as microbial ecosystems are complex, interdependent, and shaped by invisible forces, DeFi rewards people who understand feedback loops, emergent behavior, and systemic risk. Most content creators never get there. I do.

I have worked across stablecoin mechanics, RWA yield structures, DeFi automation, prediction markets, and cross-chain liquidity. Each engagement deepened my understanding as someone who reads documentation, tests products, and knows what is actually happening on-chain.

I do not shill what I cannot explain. I do not promote what I do not believe in.
